directAnswer.en: This is repair, repointing or a small patch, not a full building frame. Type 511 prints particle ≤6 mm, 3 m³/h and hose 32/38 mm. It needs 380 V. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Type 511 at 380 V, 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 30 m horizontal / 15 m vertical, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤6 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1700 × 550 × 900 mm and 260 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Type 311, which prints 220/380 V, 4 kW, 2 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 15 m horizontal / 5 m vertical, hose 25 mm, particle ≤2 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1500 × 420 × 900 mm and 150 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
